There was a family lunch afterwards.

The group was seated in 2 rows of 8 seats each.

The left row was for the family and there was one seat left.

I chose to sit in the other table.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Most of the people were my sister in law's age.

They knew who I was but no specifics.

When they introduced me to a new person, they introduced me in relationship to the people they knew.

Not who I was but how I related to someone they lived and worked with.

I prefer that someone introduce me rather than self introduction as in resume or CV

------------------------------------------------------------------------

I had known this Kim Family since my college days.

I would take the bus up to Salt Lake and their 3rd son would pick me up.

He would show me around the U of U area, sometimes in his older brother's new Red Camaro.

When he was in Utah County he would take me to see his aunt in Payson.

Payson, in those days were far end of the county, his aunt lived in outskirts of Payson, in a place known as Spring Lake.

When we were married, he was my best man.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Years passed and my mother and father moved to Utah.

Since they were similar in age and in experience, they became good friends with the Kim Family parents

Sister Kim passed away 5 years ago and I missed her funeral.

This time, the funeral was to be the day of my return from Korea, I would have missed the morning services.

However it was delayed by a day and I was able to attend all services.

Grateful I was able to attend and say thank you to the family and pay my respects to the parents of the Kim Family
